svg.title: OpenHAL components
svg.desc: Four clients, the MCP server, the CLI, the Python library and the dashboard, call the hub's local API. Inside the one hub process the API passes commands through tokens and principals to the safety kernel, which alone gives drivers a single-use grant and writes the audit log. The routine engine, watchdogs and confirmation queue also go through the kernel. Drivers reach the hardware and bridged systems.
